name: Python Dependency Taxonomy Example
description: Example taxonomy pack for classifying Python dependency failures and routing them to read-only diagnostic actions.

ownership.support: Example-only; replace with a real pack support channel before publishing.

risk_notes: Labels describe failure shape only; they do not carry shell commands, package installs, or patch content.
Suggested actions stay diagnostic until a policy pack and executor path explicitly allow more.

failure_labels.definition: A Python import fails because a required distribution is absent from the runtime environment.
Dependency metadata or lockfile information is absent or inconsistent.

safe_action_labels.description: Inspect dependency manifests and lockfiles before retrying.
Read bounded, redacted install or test output tails.

negative_examples.signal: PermissionError while importing a local file
SyntaxError in a package's Python source
